module: Jbeam post-processing step that applies the "scaleXxx" keys: for any numeric key named scale followed by a name (e.g. scaleNodeWeight), multiplies the value of the neighboring key Xxx (e.g. NodeWeight) by this factor, then removes the scale key. Recursively walks all dictionary-type sections, except those ignored by jbeam/utils (ignoreSections).
notes: The key test is strict: it must start with 'scale' (lowercase) and have at least one character after; 'scale' alone is not handled.
If the target key does not exist or is not a number, the scale key is still removed with no effect.

process.desc: Applies the scaleXxx keys across the whole vehicle (in place).
